_doc: Face blur. "all_faces": true blurs every guest face on both floors (owner request, Nov 2026): run `python pipeline/face_track.py detect <floor>`, `pose <floor>`, `track <floor>` (needs onnxruntime + pipeline/models/), then `python pipeline/encode_walk.py <floor>`; the tracked, smoothed ellipses in pipeline/faces/<floor>_tracks.json are blurred into the colour panel only. "segments": extra {floor, start_s, end_s, note} ranges for the old per-segment Haar blur (use if anyone asks to be removed and a face was missed).
